newsitem.title: USA: Dow breaks 6400 barrier, surges 40 points, eases.
newsitem.headline: Dow breaks 6400 barrier, surges 40 points, eases.

text.p: The Dow Industrials surged over forty points in the first few minutes of trading on Wednesday, breaking through the 6,400 psychological level, but quickly settled back.
The Dow jumped up 40.25 to 6437.85 and then settled back, up 16 to 6414.

The rise came on the heels of news that the September U.S. international trade deficit unexpectedly swelled 10.1 percent to a whopping $11.34 billion in September, which caused several economists to cut their third-quarter Gross Domestic Product growth forecasts.
